cohort: 540 lactating mothers from the MUAI (Maternal Nutrition and Infant Investigation) study
finding: Choline concentrations in human milk varied across lactation, with water-soluble choline being the major component and showing an increasing trend from colostrum to transitional milk before declining in mature milk, while lipid-soluble choline exhibited an opposite trajectory.
mod_finding: Choline composition varied by delivery mode.
